recipe.visualDefinition: A four-person band portrait featuring a staggered, layered depth-of-field composition against a stark white background, topped by a black header bar containing wide, geometric sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground subject dominates the lower right quadrant
Background subjects are arranged in a triangular formation
High-contrast black header bar anchors the top edge
Overexposed white background creates a clean, floating effect for the subjects
coreInvariants: Black header bar at the top
Direct eye contact from multiple subjects
Long, textured hair as a primary visual element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects at varying depths; the closest subject is large-scale in the bottom right, while others recede in scale toward the top left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large face in the bottom right foreground acts as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large foreground face, upward to the header text, then circles through the three background faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of white negative space between and behind the subjects to isolate their forms.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Natural skin tones and dark hair against the white void
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Subtle reds and golds in clothing and jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) background with mid-to-low value subjects; high contrast between the header and the image area.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars in 'E' and 'F' are perfectly centered
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and brand clarity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, geometric feel of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a four-member rock band with long hair and 90s style. Use a high-key lighting setup against a pure white background. Arrange them in a layered composition with one member very close to the camera in the bottom right, and the other three staggered behind at different depths. Leave a solid black rectangular space at the very top of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric extended sans-serif text in white, centered within the black header bar at the top.

verificationChecks: Is there a black bar at the top?
Is the text white and extended?
Is the composition layered with depth?

adjustableVariables: Width of the top black bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the foreground subject
Clean separation between subjects and white background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not touch the edges of the black bar
Verify the foreground subject is significantly larger than the background subjects
Check that the white background is blown out to pure white (#FFFFFF)
Confirm the text is all caps and extended width
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered portrait + high-key white background + black header bar + extended geometric sans-serif = 90s Rock Aesthetic.
